protocol.name: tde_window_info_v1

description.summary: where windows are on the screen

protocol.description: Tells the shell where windows are and how recently they were used, so that it can animate them from where they are, as the overview and window switchers do. The windows are those of ext-foreign-toplevel-list.

request.name: get_info
request.description: The info event of the new object answers once, and the object is destroyed by the compositor right after.

request.name: move_to_output

description.summary: put a window on another output

request.description: Moves the window to the output, as when it is dragged there in the overview. It keeps its size as far as it fits, and its place relative to the part of the output windows may use; a tiled window is tiled there the same way, and one covering an output covers that one.

event.name: info
event.description: The window's frame in the coordinates of the output layout, title bar included and shadow left out, as a picture of the window shows it. Recency is 0 for the window used last, 1 for the one before it, and so on. A window that is gone has a width and height of 0.
